title: 3.1.13 Lab: Refactor the Grade Advisor
description: Take your grade-advisor program from 2.1.42 and break it into two named, parameterless functions: decideGrade() and printAdvice(). Auto-graded.
sourceRef: refactor lab for the 3.1.12 pseudocode plan (A3.1.0), which is the plan for this lab and names both functions by the same names used here. Starts from 2-1-38-a2-1-1-grade-advisor's program.

steps.title: Keep the three variables where they are
steps.instructions: score, attendance, and lateAssignments stay as top-level variables, exactly like in 2.1.42. Neither function below takes them as a parameter — that is next module's tool. Both functions just read the outer variables directly.

steps.title: Define decideGrade
steps.instructions: Move the else-if chain that picks a recommendation string based on score into a parameterless function called decideGrade. It should log the recommendation itself, the same way it did before.

steps.title: Define printAdvice
steps.instructions: Move the check that combines attendance and lateAssignments with && or || into a parameterless function called printAdvice. It should log the review warning when the condition is true, the same way it did before.

steps.title: Call both functions
steps.instructions: Call decideGrade() and then printAdvice() so the program's output matches what 2.1.42 printed before the refactor.

planChart.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  A([Start]) --> B[set score, attendance and lateAssignments]
  B --> C[/call decideGrade: log the recommendation/]
  C --> D{printAdvice: low attendance or many late}
  D -- yes --> E[/log the review warning/]
  D -- no --> F([End])
  E --> F
